title: pterocarpus rotundifolius
intro: Pterocarpus rotundifolius, commonly known as the Mundu tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation and relieving pain. The health benefits of Pterocarpus rotundifolius include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Pterocarpus rotundifolius include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
